interpretation: Clock window starts at repair dispatch and includes reading, editing and diagnostic wait. At ready-final or deadline, seal production source; no later source edits. In-flight diagnostics may finish. Fresh complete public final and immutable-source review/binding can finish after the edit window. Each both-platform feedback request counts once even if the default service routes without SDK. Binding original actuals is not a diagnostic acquisition.
default_service_only: SDK commands are run by common integration; repairer may bind/read original facts but may not hand-select states or bypass the frozen default tool.
